question_text: A marketing application must generate original images from text prompts using foundation models available on Amazon Bedrock. Which two model families are appropriate choices for text-to-image generation on Bedrock?
explanation: Amazon Titan Image Generator and Stability AI's Stable Diffusion models on Bedrock both perform text-to-image generation. Titan Text Embeddings produces vectors for retrieval (not images), and Cohere Command is a text-generation model — neither generates images.
source_topic: Text-to-image FMs on Bedrock (Titan Image, Stable Diffusion)

question_text: A team needs to generate short video clips from text/image prompts using an Amazon foundation model on Bedrock. Which model is designed for video generation?
explanation: Amazon Nova Reel is a video-generation model in the Amazon Nova family, producing short video clips from text/image prompts. Titan Text Express generates text, Titan Multimodal Embeddings produces vectors for search, and Cohere Embed is an embedding model — none generate video.
source_topic: Amazon Nova Reel for video generation

question_text: Match the modality to the correct Amazon model: a solution must (1) generate marketing images and (2) transcribe spoken audio to text. Which pairing is correct?

options.text: Images → Amazon Titan Image Generator; Audio-to-text → Amazon Transcribe
Images → Amazon Transcribe; Audio-to-text → Titan Image Generator
Images → Amazon Polly; Audio-to-text → Amazon Rekognition
Images → Amazon Comprehend; Audio-to-text → Amazon Translate

explanation: Titan Image Generator produces images from text, and Amazon Transcribe converts speech audio to text. Polly is text-to-speech (the reverse), Rekognition analyzes images/video, Comprehend does NLP on text, and Translate converts between languages — none match the stated image-generation and speech-to-text needs except option A.
